system: Yakıt Ölçümü & Hava Emiş / Kam Mili Zamanlaması
symptoms: Scan the vehicle's onboard computer system to retrieve the specific fault code and any related data.
Inspect the wiring and connectors for any signs of damage, corrosion, or loose connections.
Check the fuse related to the oxygen sensor heater circuit to ensure it is intact.
Test the oxygen sensor using a multimeter or oscilloscope to verify if it is functioning properly.
If necessary, replace the faulty oxygen sensor or repair any wiring/connectivity issues.

questions.text: Open circuit inside oxygen sensor or open power or ground wires to oxygen sensor durumunu kontrol ettiniz mi?

pass_next: Canlı veride sinyal nominal ise arıza hafızasını silin.
fail_next: İlgili bileşeni veya kablo demetini onarın/değiştirin.
